summary: A four-track drone and atmosphere firmware for dark ambient and dungeon synth, with seven sound sources, long effects and tracks that can generate parts on their own.
features: Sources: VA, 6-op FM, sample, recorded choirs, organ, physical models, phase distortion
Four tracks share six voices; 44 factory sounds and 64 user slots
Tape per track, granular with freeze, tape echo, reverb up to infinite
64-step sequencer per track, one-key chords, arpeggiator, song slots A-D
"GENERATE" lets tracks play by themselves in key, following tempo or clock
USB and TRS MIDI, clock in and out; USB audio input; autosave

headings: the editor and the web emulator
